1.consolidated_definition: Estacionamiento. Lugar cerrado para estacionar vehículos. Anglicismo crudo, usual. Este… bueno, primero, estaban los trolis, los trolis, la San Juan Lighter. Claro, yo lo vi ya que estaba acabado aquello, donde está el parking de San Juan hoy en día, el estacionamiento. Pero... yo vi los trolis allí, los viejos trolis aquellos
1.en_consolidated_definition: Parking lot. Enclosed area for parking vehicles. Raw Anglicism, commonly used. This... well, first of all, there were the trolis, the old trolis, the San Juan Lighter. Of course, I saw it since it was already finished that place where the San Juan parking lot is located today. But... I saw the old trolis there
